reading.body:
RIC2 DC6 is one building in a planned five-building campus on 85 acres in Sandston, Virginia. The operator's public specification sheet lists 180 MW as the planned power capacity upon full completion of the Richmond 2 campus, but this figure is not yet fully operating and has not been recorded as active IT load. The campus is still under development.

At typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, the planned 180 MW campus would support approximately 4,500 racks, though actual occupancy and workload mix are not published. The operator operates a separate Richmond 1 campus in the same state. Among Virginia's 326 mapped facilities, only 23 publish power figures; Richmond 2's planned 180 MW would rank it outside the state's top 23 if fully built, placing it in a position where it would not yet materially shift Virginia's published capacity total of 1,375 MW.

The research note indicates this entry was corrected during a second pass to remove data mistakenly attributed from Richmond 1. No certifications qualifying this campus for specific workloads are published. The planned completion status and lack of operational figures mean this campus does not yet represent active constraint on AI scaling.
